name: Linde India Limited
remarksWeb: During the quarter ended 30 June 2020, The BOC Group Ltd., U.K. (Promoter Group) sold 25,276 equity shares through stock-exchange mechanism to bring down its shareholding from 75.03% to 75% of the total shares/voting rights in the Company for ensuring compliance with the minimum public shareholding requirement as per the provisions of the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Rules, 1957 as amended, SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with para 2(a) and para 3 of the SEBI circular no. SEBI/HO/CFD/CMD/CIR/P/43/2018 dated 22 February 2018.
